title: Ribboned Dream Figure
description: A graceful feminine silhouette stands in profile facing left, her body and flowing hair composed of swirling pink ribbons and fabric that dissolve into the air. She stands on cracked tiled ground as long decorative ribbons covered in roses and floral patterns drift around her against a vibrant sunset sky.
prompt: A graceful feminine silhouette in profile facing left, her body and long flowing hair entirely formed from swirling pink satin ribbons and fabric that dissolve and float into the air. Long decorative ribbons adorned with roses and floral patterns drift around her. She stands on cracked tiled ground with paint dripping from her fingers, set against a vibrant gradient sunset sky transitioning from deep purple to warm peach and pink.
